en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a statue of a uniformed man on a high pedestal inscribed "ALBERT," with a curved stone bench at its base. Behind it stands a large, early‑20th‑century building with a steep tiled roof, dormers, and a small tower, surrounded by trees and a garden. Red printed captions in German at the top read "Pegau. König Albert‑Denkmal." on the left and "Kgl. Amtsgericht." on the right.
